headline: Angola Opens $20.7 Million First National Gold Refinery in Luanda
summary: Angola inaugurated its first gold refinery, a $20.7 million facility constructed by state diamond firm Endiama, enabling local refining and international certification of gold production.
why: Endiama is Angola's state-owned diamond mining enterprise, diversifying into gold processing to retain local mineral processing value.

impacts.name: Angola
impacts.why: Opening a national gold refinery allows Angola to retain mineral processing revenues domestically.
